Period profit is split by holding % the same way, and a minimal elimination entry is output for reference.

If revaluation becomes 50,000, holding drops to 60%, current net profit −20,000, then net assets 550,000.00, parent share 330,000.00, consolidation difference −130,000.00 becomes negative goodwill, parent net profit −12,000.00.
map.负商誉可以直接计入利润吗？: Can negative goodwill be booked directly as profit?
map.按现行准则，负商誉要先把被投资方可辨认资产、负债的公允价值以及合并成本的计量复核: Under current standards, first re-examine the fair value of the investee's identifiable assets/liabilities and the measurement of combination cost; only if still negative after review is it booked as current non-operating income (or adjusted to retained earnings per standards). The review step is mandatory—skipping it may mistake a measurement error for profit.
map.少数股东权益为什么有时是负数？: Why is minority interest sometimes negative?
map.子公司净资产为负（累计亏损超过实收资本与留存收益）时，少数股东权益按比例也会是负: When sub net assets are negative (cumulative loss exceeds paid-in and retained earnings), minority interest is proportionally negative, and the page flags "insolvent". Whether to keep recognizing negative minority interest depends on whether the minority has the obligation and ability to bear excess losses; in practice judge per the charter and agreements.
map.这份测算能直接当作合并报表吗？: Can this estimate replace a consolidated statement?
map.不能。这是编制前的快速测算：只覆盖权益拆分、价差与最简抵销分录，未处理内部交易抵: No. This is a quick pre-preparation estimate covering only equity split, difference and minimal elimination; it does not handle intragroup elimination, deferred tax, or currency translation. Formal statements still need item-by-item adjustment per standards.
map.本工具按简化口径（同股同权、母公司已按权益法调整、无内部交易未实现损益）测算，正: This tool uses a simplified basis (equal rights per share, parent has applied equity method, no unrealized intragroup profits); formal elimination entries must follow the enterprise accounting standards.
map.合并价差为正记「商誉」、为负记「负商誉（营业外收入）」，商誉后续须至少每年做减值: Positive consolidation difference is booked as "goodwill", negative as "negative goodwill (non-operating income)"; goodwill must be impairment-tested at least annually thereafter.
map.少数股东权益 = 子公司净资产 × (1 − 持股比例)；子公司净资产为负时该值: Minority interest = sub net assets × (1 − holding %); when sub net assets are negative this value is negative and needs handling per the excess-loss-sharing agreement.
map.持股比例须在 0 ~ 100 之间；评估增值填负数表示评估减值。: Holding ratio must be between 0 and 100; enter a negative revaluation surplus for an impairment.
